facts.claim: First Indian industry was charcoal-based iron manufacture in Tamil Nadu in 1830.
The Tamil Nadu iron industry closed in 1886.
A large cotton textile mill was established in Mumbai in 1854; this marks industrial development.
India is a mixed economy and industry has increasing importance.
First Industrial Policy Resolution was on 6 August 1948.
Industries Development and Regulation Act 1951 was enacted during the First Plan.
1991: full liberalisation and industrial licensing abolished.
Post-1991 reforms included foreign investment, public-enterprise disinvestment, exit policy and changes to MRTP/FERA.
MRTP expanded as Monopolistic and Restrictive Trade Practice,1969.
Raw-material-oriented: iron/steel, sugar, cement, fish, meat, milk.
Skilled-labour-oriented: jewellery, diamond cutting, toys, electronics.
Footloose industries depend on markets and raw materials; paper is the example.
Primary: agriculture-based activities, mining, fishing, forest-resource activities
Tertiary: transport, banking, post, insurance, trade, tourism
MSMED Act enacted in2006; classifications can change.
